fields.description: The only doctypes whose attachments may be PUBLIC, one per line. Everything else is private, whatever the uploader ticked in the upload dialog — a rep cannot make a patient's document public by choosing to. These four are here because their images are display assets a browser must fetch without permission on the record: profile photos, contact photos, organisation logos, and the brand logo and favicon (which the login page fetches with no session at all). Removing one does not break a save; it makes that image 403 for anyone who cannot read the record it hangs off.
fields.label: Public Attachment Doctypes
